name: day-zero-cto
description: A simplified Day Zero CTO workflow for CEO reports and durable report artifacts.

interface.longDescription: Day Zero CTO is now intentionally small: initialize named CEO-report profiles for multiple repos or CTO contexts, ask for and store weekly date defaults such as Fri-Thu, save CEO report tone and artifact preferences globally, generate weekly CEO reports, generate custom-range CEO reports, and keep an index page that links every report artifact.
interface.defaultPrompt: Help me initialize Day Zero CTO and generate a CEO report.
